amplitude_count_scope: At most one ordinary bootstrap plus one measurement entry per fresh worker; internal MadLoop initialization/reduction calls are separately bounded by worker deadlines and do not count as extra sampled physical points.

deadline_policy.unlaunched_requests: Retain every immutable planned request with explicit not-launched reason when a deadline or byte cap prevents execution; never treat absence as success.

Require unmodified/disabled/enabled parity before interpreting any trace.
implementation_pending: Owned thin stage controller reusing existing supervision, process cleanup and runtime closure helpers.
Fresh CMS raw export and source inventory.
Current source-only trace emitter/filter, minimal driver hook and source-stripping proof.

Independent review of prepared native commands and immutable request set.

compare: original amplitude output fields for every split order
complete/failed contribution classification and warning evidence
common runtime ELF/provider identities; each variant executable and changed object separately hash-bound, not required to have identical file hashes
parity.failure: Retain mismatch/failure and stop dependent interpretation; do not retry, relax guards, raise thresholds, change mass policy or silently classify partial output as valid.
parity.require: Equality across unmodified, instrumented-disabled and instrumented-enabled variants before trace interpretation. This is observation parity, not a new numerical accuracy cutoff.

runtime.compiler: qualified GNU Fortran15.2.0 flags from current source campaign
runtime.host_storage: GNU/Linux x86_64 little endian; verify sizes/layout before decode

stages.after_generation: Retain raw CLI sources/cards/log and verify generated CMS provenance before source instrumentation; stop here for review.
stages.scope: Archive exact0fcd source into new private tree, copy preverified dependencies/model, invoke one current CMS CLI command. No baseline export, installer, or physics policy change.

Fresh CMS common objects plus unmodified private process build; EW reuses verified current MODEL/DHELAS archives but rebuilds process and driver objects privately. Record full effective compiler flags, commands and dependency identities.
Compile only the reviewed trace-changed CT/TIRUST and private control/driver objects, then relink. Unchanged objects/archives match the unmodified private variant.
Fresh worker per process/mode/variant, trace disabled throughout ordinary bootstrap, then exactly one measurement point.
Run only after ordinary parity, fresh worker per point/mode/variant, one measurement point after trace-disabled bootstrap.

trace_filter.overflow_action: Stop and retain truncated file as incomplete; never silently truncate or continue it as complete.
